methods.description: Decide whether a quantity needs size only or size and direction,and explain scalar/vector classification.

Read tail-to-arrowhead endpoint order and vector-variable notation;reverse endpoints reverse direction while keeping magnitude.
Use bars for scalar vector size,interpret speed or same-segment length,and recognise nonnegative magnitude.
Distinguish scalar multiplication/vector-to-vector sums from invalid scalar/vector addition or subtraction.
